correctness.rationale: For every p>=5 the discriminant of phi8 is 2^31, so C is smooth genus3. The invariant-function field of the explicit involution on the genus7 curve w²=z^16+1 is exactly k(C). On seven Hasse–Witt basis directions the nonzero coefficients are binomial((p-1)/2,k), with k integral in [0,(p-1)/2]; no coefficient vanishes modulo p. Paired directions have complementary k and equal coefficients, so the rank of the restriction equals the number of residue arrows. Exhausting the eight odd residues modulo16 gives the theorem table for all primes; stable ranks and a=3-rank follow. The delivered exact checker separately tests all 44 primes <200; finite testing is auxiliary and no Newton polygon is asserted.

value.rationale: This determines a natural complete characteristic-wise arithmetic invariant of the first genus-three even Chebyshev octic. The eight residue classes show a genuine diversity of stable rank 0,1,2,3, and distinguish nonsuperspecial p-rank-zero Jacobians from a superspecial one and a-number 1 versus 2 at fixed rank one. Those finer strata are not settled by maximal-point criteria and give exact data for the arithmetic geometry of Chebyshev covers. The scientific contribution is the full classification; the previously known superspecial row alone is not counted as new value.
